source.citation: Shahbazi, Menard, Sohn, Theau (2019), Unmanned aerial image dataset: Ready for 3D reconstruction. Data in Brief 25, 103962. DOI 10.1016/j.dib.2019.103962

processing.method: Built sampled display frustums from refined exterior and interior orientation parameters, using a capped display length and the same scene transform as the TLS preview.

sceneTransform.note: Frustum vertices are centered and lifted with the same transform as the sampled TLS preview.

processing.orientationConvention: Preview uses Rz(kappa) * Ry(phi) * Rx(omega), negative camera Z as forward. Verify convention before metric use.

reviewStatus.notes: This is a sampled visual QA layer for camera acquisition geometry. It is not a final photogrammetric camera model or image footprint product.
